extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, authors, peer reviewers and journal editors reporting or evaluating clinical prediction model studies that use regression or machine learning methods
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for transparent reporting of studies that develop or evaluate clinical prediction models using regression or machine learning methods, including full-paper and abstract checklists and related resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: Reporting of prediction model development and performance evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting of studies that develop a prediction model or evaluate its performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the primary target of the TRIPOD+AI statement — studies that develop or validate clinical prediction models (diagnostic or prognostic) using regression or machine learning methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study design applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Artificial intelligence/Machine learning studies, Diagnostic and prognostic studies, Observational studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TRIPOD+AI applies to studies across these designs; authors should identify which study design their work uses and report accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applies to whole report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline is intended to be used for the entire manuscript (not only specific sections), and related checklists exist for full reports and abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TRIPOD+AI checklist (full paper)
rubrics_metrics.description: The TRIPOD+AI checklist (PDF) is available in Supplementary Table 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use the full TRIPOD+AI checklist when preparing manuscripts; the checklist enumerates items to include for complete, transparent reporting (full checklist available in the statement paper's supplementary material).

rubrics_metrics.name: TRIPOD+AI Expanded Checklist (Explanation & Elaboration Light)
rubrics_metrics.description: The TRIPOD+AI Expanded Checklist (PDF) (Explanation & Elaboration Light) is available in Supplementary Table 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An expanded checklist with brief E&E material is provided to give additional explanation for checklist items until the full TRIPOD+AI E&E paper is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: TRIPOD+AI for Abstracts checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: The TRIPOD+AI for Abstracts checklist is available in Table 3 of the statement paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A tailored checklist exists for abstracts to ensure essential reporting elements are present when space is limited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of prior TRIPOD E&E while TRIPOD+AI E&E pending
rubrics_metrics.description: Please continue to use the TRIPOD 2015 E&E paper until the TRIPOD+AI E&E paper is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 2015 TRIPOD Explanation & Elaboration should be used as the explanatory resource for checklist items until the dedicated TRIPOD+AI E&E is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence assessment and measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: An adherence assessment form for measuring adherence to the Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD) statement has been developed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adherence assessment forms (available from the tripod-statement website) can be used by researchers, reviewers, or editors to measure completeness of reporting against TRIPOD/TRIPOD+AI items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related / specialised reporting guideline selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant more generic / specialised reporting guidelines (i.e. main generic guideline or extension to a generic guideline) — examples listed: TRIPOD-SRMA, TRIPOD-Cluster, TRIPOD-LLM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consider whether a specialised TRIPOD extension is more appropriate for their study (for example TRIPOD-SRMA for systematic reviews of prediction model studies, TRIPOD-Cluster for clustered data, TRIPOD-LLM for large language model work) and use the corresponding checklist/extension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version history and provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: Previous versions of this guideline / Guideline history — TRIPOD 2015 and subsequent publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognise TRIPOD+AI as an update/extension of TRIPOD 2015; historic TRIPOD documents and translations may remain relevant for interpretation and application until full TRIPOD+AI resources are available in multiple languages.
